A '''duel''' occurred on [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] after [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] discovered that [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was responsible for the sabotage of [[Viscount (title)/Legends|Viscount]] [[Harko Vane]]. This sabotage lead to his death. Obi-Wan Kenobi tried to inform the viscount's widow, [[Elodore Vane]], of the event. En route, he was confronted by Ventress. After a brief duel Kenobi made his escape.
